The [[Doan]] '''mining caste''' was a group of lower-class [[Mining/Legends|miners]] that made up a large percent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] population. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]], the mining caste came into conflict with the planet's rulers, the [[Doan Royal House]]. In [[980 BBY]], the miners attempted to force [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]]'s [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] into an emergency landing, but accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] him. This sent his wife, Princess [[Serra]], into a depression. Serra's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], hired an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]], to assassinate [[Gelba]], a leader of the mining caste, in the hopes of heloping Serra recover from her depression. Meanwhile, the caste contacted the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to send someone to negotiate the situation on Doan; the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sent a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Medd Tandar]]. As Tandar met with Gelba and five other miners, they were [[Massacre on Doan|attacked]] by the Huntress, who shot Gelba and all five miners before killing Tandar as well, sparking a diplomatic incident.
